name: Portrait of a masked woman
source:
You are a painter cursed with a blank canvas you can't quite figure out how to fill.

[From [url=https://nepcoolestnuisance.itch.io/portrait-of-a-masked-woman]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是個畫家，像遭了詛咒一般，守著一方空白畫布，怎麼也想不出該往上面畫些什麼。

［摘自[url=https://nepcoolestnuisance.itch.io/portrait-of-a-masked-woman]itch.io[/url]］
